\caption{Predator--prey system at $T=40$ (5{,}803 events). For each stoichiometric channel: every candidate mass-action reaction, then the channel's propensity and its $L^2$ distance to the true propensity. True: rate $k^*$ (bold if active) and propensity. Bayes: posterior mean and 95\% credible interval (CrI); a reaction is included if $\Pr(\text{off})<1/2$ (median probability model \cite{Barbieri2004}) and otherwise reported as $0$. Here every included reaction has $\Pr(\text{off})=0.000$ and every excluded one $\Pr(\text{off})\ge0.993$. LASSO-MA and LASSO-BB: the LASSO of \cite{siam_Zhang2019} at $\lambda=0.01$, restricted to the candidate reactions (MA; $k=2c$ for $2X$ reactants) or with all polynomials of order $\le 2$ (BB). Numbers are rounded to three decimals: $0$ is an exact zero, $0.000$ a nonzero value below $5\times10^{-4}$ in magnitude. Propensities show terms with $|c|\ge 0.001$; $^\dagger$~term that no candidate reaction of the channel produces, or negative.}
